title: Status Saver・Status Downloader
summary: Status Saver with Downloader. Easily download, save & share any status.
description:
HOW TO USE…?
✓ Check your desired statuses.
✓ Go back to the Status Saver app and scroll down to refresh.
✓ That's it, now download or share your statuses with your friends

Status Saver - Status Downloader is here to help you download or share your friends' statuses with just one click. You can save your desired image or video statues to your gallery or share them with friends directly in the WA Status Saver app. Status Downloader has its own media player so you can play your desired video status in the app and also download or share those videos with friends. You don't need internet to use the status saver app, it's totally offline.

KEY FEATURES… 😊
♥ Simple tutorial on how to use the app on first launch.
♥ Scroll down to refresh.
♥ Swipe statues left or right.
♥ Built-in media player.
♥ No internet required to use the app.
♥ Fast save, no need to wait.
♥ Share or repost without saving.
♥ View saved statuses from your gallery within the app.
♥ Smart and elegant interface.
♥ Control the app interface from settings.
♥ Simple and easy controls for users.
♥ Minimal ads.
♥ Support for multiple statuses (Normal / Business)
